entries.description: 6v12 variant for AI tuning: the player elite mage + 1 archer are replaced by 2 elite archers (4 sword + 2 archer, no mage), built by BattleSimFormalCombatFixture._build_mixed_6v12_two_archer_roster(). Same 30x18 canyon map as the baseline. Dropping the mage removes ~2/3 of player damage, giving a less lopsided matchup with tuning headroom. Not a balance baseline.
